name: SAOImageDS9
product: SAOImageDS9 by the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory / Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian

evidence.says: The project’s 8.8.1 download page offers a universal macOS 12+ Aqua build for Apple Silicon and Intel and dates the release November 5, 2026.

notes: The project also offers a separate universal X11 build that requires XQuartz.

name: TFBWebATM
product: Taipei Fubon Bank’s WebATM smart-card security component for macOS

evidence.says: The bank documents TFBWebATM.pkg as the Safari-compatible component that verifies transactions using a chip card.

notes: This is a companion component for the bank’s browser workflow.

name: OpenMW
product: OpenMW by the OpenMW project

evidence.says: The OpenMW team announced the stable 0.51.0 release on June 19, 2026.
The official 0.51.0 assets include OpenMW-0.51.0-macOS-arm64.dmg and a separate x86_64 DMG.

notes: OpenMW requires separately obtained Morrowind game data.

name: SuperCollider
product: SuperCollider by the SuperCollider project

evidence.says: The project offers SuperCollider 3.14.1 as a universal macOS 11+ binary alongside a legacy x64 build.
The project published the stable 3.14.1 release on November 24, 2025 UTC.

name: PageEdit
product: PageEdit visual XHTML editor by Sigil-Ebook

evidence.says: The project links to the 2.7.6 macOS ARM64 package as the latest Apple Silicon download.
The project’s versioned asset list contains PageEdit.app-2.7.6-Mac-arm64.txz and a separate x86_64 build, both uploaded on March 19, 2026.

notes: PageEdit also runs as a general-purpose visual XHTML editor outside Sigil.

name: 010 Editor
product: 010 Editor by SweetScape Software

evidence.says: SweetScape lists a separate macOS ARM 64-bit installer for version 17.0.2.
SweetScape dates version 17.0.2 to November 23, 2026.

name: Flash Player
product: Adobe Flash Player for Mac, originally Macromedia Flash Player

evidence.says: Adobe ended support on December 31, 2020, removed the download pages and blocked Flash content from January 12, 2021.
The Flash Player release history dates the Mac 32.0.0.465 runtime to December 8, 2020.

limitation: The batch reports the scanned build as non-native, but the retail Mac executable was not independently inspected.
notes: The end-of-life notice covers Adobe’s general distribution of Flash Player.

name: SmartSVN
product: SmartSVN by syntevo GmbH

evidence.says: Syntevo offers SmartSVN 14.5.1 as a separate Apple Silicon DMG for macOS 11–26 alongside the Intel build.
The official changelog dates SmartSVN 14.5.1 to October 8, 2025.

name: Chiaki
product: Chiaki PlayStation Remote Play client by Florian Märkl (thestr4ng3r)

evidence.says: The original author's SourceHut tag dated August 20, 2023 lists Chiaki-v2.2.0-macOS-x86_64.dmg as its only Mac asset.
Homebrew identifies the 2.2.0 Mac build as Intel-only and says it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: Current Gatekeeper behavior and end-to-end playback were not tested.
notes: Homebrew disabled the cask for a Gatekeeper check. Chiaki-ng is a separate fork.

name: Front
product: Front desktop client by FrontApp, Inc.

evidence.says: Front’s official CDN serves the versioned 3.82.3 macOS ZIP explicitly named arm64.
The live Homebrew API lists Front 3.82.3 with separate arm64 and x64 macOS downloads from the vendor.
Front’s macOS installation documentation provides distinct Apple Silicon and Intel packages.

name: Cheat Engine 7.3
product: Cheat Engine for macOS by the Cheat Engine project (Eric Heijnen)

evidence.says: The project offers Cheat Engine 7.7 for Mac, and inspection of CheatEngine77.zip found x86_64 and arm64 slices in CheatEngine77.app/Contents/MacOS/cheatengine.
The developer announced Cheat Engine 7.7 for macOS on May 29, 2026.

notes: The versioned listing refers to the earlier Intel bundle, org.cheatengine.cheatengine-x86_64. The current Mac release uses org.cheatengine.cheatengine and identifies itself as version 7.7.

name: 1Clipboard
product: 1Clipboard clipboard manager by NGWIN

evidence.says: The vendor links to 1Clipboard.dmg, whose 1Clipboard.app Info.plist reports version 0.1.8 and com.ngwin.1clipboard and whose Contents/MacOS/1Clipboard executable is x86_64 only.

limitation: No app-specific evidence verified that this build runs under Rosetta 2, and no release date was confirmed.

name: Panda
product: Panda, unidentified Qt/QMake Mac bundle sddda.Panda

evidence.says: The original scan identifies a Qt/QMake executable named Panda with bundle ID sddda.Panda and no published app version or vendor.

limitation: No attributable publisher, product function, or official distribution could be identified.
notes: The category is provisional because the product function is unknown.

name: PandaBar
product: PandaBar Pandora menu-bar client by Maha Software

evidence.says: The thread reproduces Maha Software’s notice that Pandora’s actions led to PandaBar’s removal from the Mac App Store and prevented continued distribution.
The original scan records Maha Software’s bundle at 1.3.0 with Intel slices.

limitation: The known 1.3.0 build was Intel-only and its status as the final build is unconfirmed.

name: GoToMeeting (18425)
product: Classic GoToMeeting desktop client by LogMeIn, now GoTo

evidence.says: GoTo staff state that the classic desktop client is no longer available and that customers migrated to the new GoTo app.
Homebrew identifies the archived classic Mac build 19950 as Intel and documents its Rosetta 2 requirement.

limitation: Build 19950 was Intel-only and its status as the final Mac build is unconfirmed.
notes: The current GoTo desktop app is a separate successor.

name: BankID
product: BankID Security Application for Swedish BankID on card and file, by Finansiell ID-Teknik

evidence.says: The cask identifies the Swedish BankID package and its vendor-hosted 7.18.0 installer, whose SHA-256 matched the downloaded copy.

BankID's official installer site serves the desktop application, and inspection of BankID_installation_7_18_0.pkg found a universal x86_64 and arm64 BankID.app/Contents/MacOS/BankID executable with bundle ID com.bankid.BankID and version 7.18.0.

limitation: The release date was not confirmed.
notes: The inspected app declares macOS 12.0 as its minimum version.

name: Deepnest.io
product: Deepnest.io by Jack Qiao

evidence.says: The original product site still distributes Deepnest-1.0.5-mac.zip, whose Deepnest-mac-1.0.5.app/Contents/MacOS/Deepnest.io executable inspected as x86_64 only.
Homebrew's cask maintainers discuss deprecation of the abandoned original and distinguish it from the separately maintained fork.
The original developer's repository identifies deepnest.io as the official download site.

limitation: No official release date or conclusive Rosetta 2 compatibility evidence was found.
notes: The original project is unmaintained and its last distributed Mac build is Intel-only; Deepnest Next is a separate fork.

name: Pinball
product: Pinball by baKno Games

evidence.says: The developer's Mac download yields Pinball.app 10.2.0 with bundle ID com.bakno.pinball, and its Contents/MacOS/Pinball executable contains i386 and x86_64 slices only.
Apple's lookup identifies the exact bundle and reports the separate Mac App Store release as 10.1.0.

limitation: No release date or credible Rosetta 2 runtime report was found for the vendor's direct 10.2.0 build.
notes: The vendor page heading says 10.1, while the downloaded app's own version metadata reports 10.2.0.

name: Grids
product: Grids for Instagram by ThinkTime Creations LLC

evidence.says: Inspection of the official 8.5.8 ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices in Grids.app/Contents/MacOS/Grids.
Homebrew identifies Grids 8.5.8 as the current direct-download version of the Instagram desktop client.
Apple’s US lookup returns no current listing for the original com.thinktimecreations.GridsLite Mac App Store bundle.

limitation: The inspected build uses com.thinktimecreations.Grids, and the executable architecture of the Mac App Store edition com.thinktimecreations.GridsLite remains unverified.
notes: The native claim covers the vendor’s direct-download edition of Grids.

name: Prime95
product: Prime95 by GIMPS / George Woltman

evidence.says: GIMPS lists macOS 30.19 build 20 as an Intel-only command-line release and macOS GUI 29.8 build 7 as an Intel-only legacy build.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation of either build was not verified.
notes: The scanned Prime95.app corresponds to the GUI line, and the current project download is the command-line edition.

name: 115Browser
product: 115Browser (115浏览器) by 115 Technology

evidence.says: The vendor’s macOS download section offers distinct builds for Apple chips and Intel chips.
The vendor’s download feed supplies version 36.0.1, the 115br_v36.0.1_arm64.dmg URL and the August 19, 2026 update date for the Apple-chip edition.
The cask independently records the vendor’s matching 36.0.1 arm64 and x64 DMGs for 115Browser.app.

name: Archetype Nolly
product: Archetype: Nolly standalone guitar amp simulator by Neural DSP Technologies

evidence.says: Neural DSP identifies the original Archetype: Nolly 2.0.2 standalone app as a universal binary with native Apple Silicon support.
The vendor’s Past Releases data still lists the macOS installer for Archetype: Nolly 2.0.2 with a June 8, 2023 catalog date.

notes: The Downloads page lists the original build under Past Releases for Archetype: Nolly X, which installs separately. Neural DSP posted its announcement on June 7, 2023.

name: Bookpedia
product: Bookpedia by Bruji

evidence.says: Bruji's current direct download is Bookpedia 7.0, and the inspected Bookpedia.app/Contents/MacOS/Bookpedia executable contains x86_64 and arm64 slices.
The official Sparkle feed dates Bookpedia 7.0 build 310, which matches the inspected app metadata, to July 3, 2026.

notes: The stable direct build is 310. The Apple Silicon announcement from 2024 covered an earlier beta.

name: Polypad
product: Polypad Scriptable Textpad by Mattebot, LLC

evidence.says: Apple's lookup ties the scanned bundle ID to the Mac app Polypad Scriptable Textpad, version 1.5.3.
Mattebot's Mac App Store listing dates version 1.5.3 to October 14, 2024 and supplies platform requirements without CPU architecture.

limitation: The current Mac executable's architecture is unverified, and the developer site redirected away from the product.

name: Zen Pinball 2
product: Zen Pinball 2 by Zen Studios

evidence.says: Zen Studios' Mac App Store page lists version 1.4.3 dated June 17, 2025 with an in-app purchase restoration fix and no stated CPU architecture.
A customer on the Argentinian App Store reports in 2022 that they played the game on their M1 Mac through Rosetta.

limitation: The Rosetta report predates version 1.4.3, whose architecture and Apple Silicon runtime have not been verified.

name: 1Click Duplicate Finder
product: 1Click Duplicate Finder by SEASOFT LTD.

evidence.says: Apple's lookup confirms the exact bundle ID belongs to SEASOFT's 1Click Duplicate Finder 2.4.0.
The vendor's version history lists 2.4.0 as current and describes an earlier release as M1-ready without specifying a binary architecture.

limitation: No arm64 or universal statement was found for version 2.4.0, and the earlier M1 wording does not distinguish native support from Rosetta.

name: Nums
product: Nums trackpad keypad app by Luckey, distributed in Japan by ADZUKI Trading

evidence.says: The official Japanese download page links to Luckey’s current macOS download endpoint.
Inspection of the vendor DMG found x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices in Nums.app/Contents/MacOS/Nums and confirmed bundle ID cn.luckey.nums-blue and build 2.0.9.

notes: The Info.plist displays version 2.0, and the vendor filename and CFBundleVersion identify build 2.0.9.

name: TCANLINPro
product: TCANLINPro CAN and LIN bus analysis software by Toomoss

evidence.says: The project identifies TCANLINPro as Toomoss’s software for its USB-to-CAN/LIN adapters and links the vendor download.
The distributor identifies TCANLINPro as the desktop software used to monitor and record CAN and LIN traffic on a Toomoss adapter.

limitation: The vendor download returned a verification page, and I could not establish a current official Mac release or its architecture.
notes: The scanner’s com.yourcompany prefix is a placeholder.

name: TorGuardDesktopQt
product: TorGuard VPN stable desktop client by TorGuard (TorGuardDesktopQt)

evidence.says: TorGuard lists 4.8.29 as its stable Mac release, and the linked TorGuard-v4.8.29.dmg contains Install TorGuard.pkg with an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/TorGuardDesktopQt and matching bundle ID.
The unversioned Mac setup guide claims a universal distribution and links a different installer URL from the stable 4.8.29 entry.
TorGuard says the current stable legacy client is available alongside a separate rebuilt desktop app in beta.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation for the exact 4.8.29 build was not independently verified.
notes: The architecture finding applies to the stable Qt client package linked by TorGuard, including its Info.plist short version 4.8.29.

name: Adobe Lens Profile Creator
product: Adobe Lens Profile Creator for Mac by Adobe

evidence.says: Adobe links the 1.0.4 Mac image, whose Adobe Lens Profile Creator.app/Contents/MacOS/Adobe Lens Profile Creator executable is 32-bit i386 only and whose bundle ID matches the listing.
Apple states that macOS dropped support for 32-bit apps with macOS Catalina 10.15.

limitation: The Mac package release date was not confirmed.
notes: The disk image and outer folder identify release 1.0.4, while the app plist identifies internal build 1.0.

name: Audirvana
product: Audirvāna 3.5 legacy desktop player by Audirvāna

evidence.says: Audirvāna published the 3.5.50 release note on September 24, 2021.
The vendor’s forum identifies 3.5.50 as the unsupported legacy line after Studio launched.
Inspection of Audirvana.app/Contents/MacOS/Audirvana in the vendor’s 3.5.50 DMG showed x86_64 and arm64 slices for com.audirvana.Audirvana.

notes: The final legacy build was universal and its download remains online; Audirvāna Studio and Origin are the current products.

name: RAR Extractor Max
product: RAR Extractor - Unzip File (formerly RAR Extractor MAX) by Elimisoft

evidence.says: Elimisoft lists RAR Extractor MAX as a Mac product and links to App Store item 1535136051.
The Mac-specific App Store view of the same item now uses the name RAR Extractor - Unzip File and lists Mac version 13.9.6.
Apple associates the exact bundle ID with the same App Store item and dates the shared storefront update to August 3, 2026.

limitation: No CPU architecture statement or inspectable official Mac package was found for 13.9.6.
notes: The App Store item also has mobile builds with a separate version number; use the Mac-specific storefront.

name: Pinball Arcade
product: Pinball Arcade by FarSight Studios

evidence.says: The Mac App Store identifies FarSight's 8.2.0 release dated July 18, 2019 without a CPU architecture declaration.
A May 2022 Mac App Store review reports running the game on an M1 MacBook Air with severe keyboard input lag.
FarSight's Steam listing specifies an Intel processor for its Mac build.

limitation: The current Mac App Store executable's architecture was not verified, and the M1 user report does not say whether Rosetta was used.
notes: The Mac App Store build matches the scanned short version. The Steam system requirements may describe a different build.

name: ActivInspire
product: ActivInspire interactive teaching software by Promethean

evidence.says: Promethean lists an Intel Core i3 or faster as the minimum Mac processor for ActivInspire.
Knox County Schools documents ActivInspire’s Intel-code dependency on its Apple Silicon Macs and explains continued use in the Rosetta period.
The Mac patch catalogue identifies ActivInspire 3.5.18 as Promethean’s macOS release.
The indexed copy of Promethean’s version history dates ActivInspire 3.5.18 to January 22, 2025.

limitation: No Mach-O inspection ties the Rosetta requirement to every executable in the 3.5.18 package.

name: SopCast
product: SopCast peer-to-peer streaming client by the SopCast Team

evidence.says: The Mac download catalog identifies 1.6.4 as the latest release from the SopCast Team and describes the application as discontinued.
The historical scan identifies com.sopcast.SopCast 1.6.4 as an Intel build.

limitation: The vendor download and retirement notice could not be verified, and Rosetta operation remains unverified.
notes: The last identified Mac build was Intel-only.

name: AppDelete
product: AppDelete standalone uninstaller by Reggie Ashworth

evidence.says: Homebrew disabled AppDelete because it was discontinued, following an earlier deprecation for the same reason.
The final cask definition at the disable commit pins AppDelete to version 4.3.3 and lists the exact com.apps4macs.AppDelete bundle identifier in its paths.
A longtime AppDelete user identifies the legacy app as Intel-only.

limitation: The last independently identifiable release is 4.3.3, whose original binary and precise release date could not be verified.
notes: The former vendor site now redirects to an unrelated site, so it is unsuitable as an official link.

name: Steven Slate Audio Center
product: Steven Slate Audio Center by Steven Slate Audio / Yellow Matter Entertainment

evidence.says: The vendor labels the single current Mac download M1/Intel, and its link resolves to SAC_Mac_3.2.4.dmg.
Current vendor instructions describe Audio Center as an independently installed application for account sign-in and software management.

limitation: The M1/Intel label does not specify the app executable’s architecture, and the 186 MB DMG exceeds the brief’s inspection limit.
notes: Compatibility statements for VSX, MSX and Steven Slate Drums describe software delivered through Audio Center.

name: Adobe Color Printer Utility
product: Adobe Color Printer Utility (ACPU) by Adobe

evidence.says: The inventory records Adobe Color Printer Utility 1.0 with the exact bundle ID and identifies it as Intel-only on five devices.
A user reports operating Adobe Color Printer Utility 1.0 on an M1 Ultra with macOS Ventura 13.1 and describes an A4 printing issue.
Adobe identifies the Mac utility and states that macOS Catalina 10.15 and later are outside official support.
A user reports that the utility returned a color profile error when trying to print from a 2023 iMac on macOS Tahoe.

limitation: Rosetta 2 is inferred from the Intel-only inventory and the M1 runtime report, and successful printing on current macOS remains unverified.
notes: The official support article remains live, but its linked Mac DMG returned HTTP 404 during the audit.

name: MotionPro Plus
product: MotionPro Plus by Array Networks

evidence.says: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics identifies the Mac MotionPro Plus client as an App Store distribution separate from the downloadable desktop client.
A mirrored listing identifies Array Networks' separate MotionPro Plus Mac App Store product as item 1218085720 and reports version 2.0.2 with an Intel requirement.
Apple's United States lookup returns no current listing for Mac App Store item 1218085720.
The vendor supplies a newer MotionPro desktop client whose inspected 1.2.22 package contains com.arraynetworks.motionpro, a different bundle from MotionPro Plus.

limitation: The final MotionPro Plus executable and release date were unavailable, so its reported Intel architecture was not independently verified.
notes: The former Mac App Store item was absent from Apple lookups in the United States, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the United Kingdom and Australia.

name: 360Chrome
product: 360Chrome (360极速浏览器 for Mac) by Qihoo 360

evidence.says: The published XProtect configuration associates net.qihoo.360browser with the 360Chrome executable.
A customer on Qihoo's forum identifies the scanned 12.2.1636.0 version as 360极速浏览器 and describes trying it after an update on an M2 Mac.
Qihoo offers a native Apple-chip build of the current 360极速浏览器 Pro, with version 16.0.1098.0 in the official installer link.
Apple identifies the similarly named current App Store browser as com.qihoo.litebrowserx, a different bundle ID.

limitation: The current native Pro download's bundle identity could not be confirmed as net.qihoo.360browser.
notes: Qihoo's direct Apple-chip installer exceeds the audit's binary inspection size limit.
